name: Time Change
description: Coverage of daylight saving time in the United States and abroad: the dates clocks move forward and back, federal proposals to make daylight time permanent, state laws that only take effect if Congress acts, and places such as Hawaii and most of Arizona that do not change clocks. Stories give the exact local time of the change, explain what happens to the hour that is skipped or repeated, and link to the daylight saving guide and the month calendars where the change appears, so planners know which weekend to watch.
